_about: Google rich-result features as currently supported, pinned 2026-11-10. Source: Google Search Central, 'Structured data markup that Google Search supports' (search gallery), last updated 2026-10-16 UTC, read 2026-11-10. The gallery lists 25 features. Only features this site's markup can plausibly target are mapped to schema types below; the full gallery list is recorded for the drift check. Eligibility is not display: Google does not guarantee a rich result for valid markup.

Article.note: NewsArticle maps to the Article feature.

Local business.note: Mapped for the LocalBusiness family generally; the validator applies this at the family level, not per subtype.

Profile page.note: Only where the page is primarily about that person/organization.

FAQPage.detail: Google stopped showing FAQ rich results on 2026-05-07; FAQ documentation, Search Console report and Rich Results Test support were removed in June 2026. FAQPage remains a valid schema.org type (schema.org/FAQPage, a WebPage subtype). Markup aimed at this feature is drift: warn, do not fail.

HowTo.detail: Removed from mobile 2023-08 and desktop 2023-09. Valid schema.org vocabulary.

_maintenance: Review when the standards watch notes a Google Search Central changelog entry touching structured data, or at most quarterly. One file, ~30 minutes per review.
